primary_models.storage_name_note: The local directory retains the historical SmolLM-1.7B prefix; it contains SmolLM2-1.7B.

boundary_models.role: boundary-family check; not required for the primary reproduction path
floor-effect check; not required for the primary reproduction path

provenance_limitations.checkpoint_revisions: The original local downloads did not record Hugging Face commit hashes. This release therefore records canonical model identifiers but does not claim byte-identical checkpoint provenance. Future reruns should record snapshot revisions before quantization.
provenance_limitations.dataset_revision: The release fixes GSM8K document indices and protocol, but the original cached dataset revision was not retained. Future reruns should record the Hugging Face dataset fingerprint.

quantization.sg_mmp: Sensitive transformer layers are W8; other q/k/v projections are W8; o/gate/up/down projections are GPTQ-W4.

direct_gsm8k_500.few_shot_examples: first five rows of the GSM8K training split
direct_gsm8k_500.statistics: two-sided exact McNemar test and 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples

selection_note: The original Qwen2.5-0.5B sensitivity screen used the first 300 GSM8K test documents. The release includes a 381-example non-overlap robustness analysis; it must be reported alongside, rather than treating the full 500-example direct result as completely selection-independent.
